name: Sasaki Reina
source:
Aria's childhood friend. She is calm, quick-witted, calculating, cool beauty. In fact, she is a bit of a pushover, and is not very good at dealing with unexpected situations. 

She is not good at social group interactions, which women are typically good with, and does not care if she is not well-liked by her own gender.

Not being able to stand the thought of masturbating alone anymore, she confesses her love to the protagonist and proceeds to take his dick in her mouth.

When it comes to sex, she believes that it is important act to maintain oneself (She doesn't really know, since she's a virgin).
